title: Velocity Portrait — Route Inspector & Token Stream Tiles
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact "Velocity Portrait" inspector that surfaces per-route and per-model token emission and latency behavior as a set of small, composition-friendly tiles. The goal is to help engineers and PMs quickly triage whether load/latency issues are due to batching, KV cache miss patterns, or sudden token volume spikes. This ticket covers visual specification, micro-interactions for streaming traces, and a clickable prototype for dev handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Four tile types defined with visual specs: Token Stream (sparkline + rate), Batch Distribution (histogram), Latency Ridgeline (P50/P95 bands), KV Cache Heatmap (time x hit-rate)
Prototype that plays back a 3-minute synthetic trace with streaming token emission and hover drilldown to per-batch detail
Accessibility: color choices meet contrast AA for data-highlighting states and keyboard focus works for tile drilldown
Design tokens and CSS tokens exported for engineering with spacing/typography/animation guidelines
Handoff doc and telemetry contract documented for ENG (fields required, sampling rules)
review_notes: PM (Jordan Li) - Wants default view to open on 5m window with ability to switch to 1h; highlight sudden token-rate jumps as primary signal
Eng (Priya Shah) - Raised telemetry concern: current request logs don't emit per-batch sizes; suggested backend schema change ENG-90234
Data (Mateo Alvarez) - Suggested smoothing param for sparkline to avoid false positives during bursty workloads
Design critique (Internal) - Reduce visual weight of ridgeline by removing inner grid lines; provide microcopy for cache hit tooltip
decisions: Default timeframe: 5 minutes (fast triage) with 1h and 24h presets
Color palette: use 'signal' colors for delta highlights (green/orange/red) and neutral grayscale for baseline traces
Sampling: prototype and UI assume 1:10 sampling for detailed microtraces; full ingestion optional behind Dedicated customers
Tile layout: 2x2 compact grid for embed in route summary; expandable 1-up canvas for deep-dive
engineering_notes: ENG contract required: add fields 'batch_size', 'kv_cache_hit', 'emitted_tokens' to per-request telemetry (see ENG-90234)
Backend needs an endpoint to stream synthetic traces for prototype playback (ticket ENG-91300)
Performance: client should avoid redrawing ridgeline more than 2x/sec for streaming updates to keep console CPU low
Provide mock JSON payloads in the handoff doc under design_links confluence page
next_steps: Incorporate PM feedback and update prototype by 2026-03-05 (assigned to Rafael)
Create ENG spike for telemetry contract and cost estimates (owner Priya Shah)
Set up a 30-minute design walk-through with Eng and Data on 2026-03-08
Publish handoff packet and mark Ready for Dev once ENG-90234 is scheduled
